content:
Kim expects to have 3 + 5 = 8 clients.  
Each client requires 2 bottles of bleach ($2 each) and 1 pack of cloths ($5), so expenses per client are (2 × $2) + $5 = $9.  
Total weekly expenses = 8 × $9 = $72.  
Total weekly income = $92.  
Profit = Income − Expenses = $92 − $72 = $20.

Answer: 20
